description: Finnish company lookup by Business ID or name (PRH). Looks up the Finnish Trade Register (PRH/YTJ) by Business ID such as 0112038-9 or by company name. Returns business ID, current name, company form, registration date, end date if dissolved, main industry, website and address. Use for KYB in Finland. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).
